changelog:
- Major update: Robustness and new browser-based fallback for Douyin anti-crawling (2026-08).
- Now uses multi-level video direct link extraction: iesdouyin API → CDP browser (Edge/Chrome headless) → yt-dlp, with automatic switching.
- No API key, account login, or manual cookies needed for browser mode; launches isolated headless browser to handle anti-crawl and extract video/audio.
- Improved "金句卡片" (Golden Quotes) extraction algorithm: now up to 8 candidates, better for Chinese unscripted videos, with advanced sentence cutting and scoring for highlight selection.
- Updated capability declarations for transparency: details on headless browser use, temporary file handling, and model management.
- Documentation and usage help now clarify anti-crawling state, fallback process, environment checks, and safe handling; unused text & config files (README, LICENSE…) removed.
